headlines.text: On this day in 2024, the AEW World Tag Team Titles changed hands as Allin & Sting vs. The Young Bucks battled it out in a Tornado Tag match, appearing on Revolution, rated 9.45 ? one of the greatest matches in company history ? ending the champion's reign at 5 defenses. In what became Sting's final match, the 64-year-old legend and Darby Allin fought off the Young Bucks with help from a ringside Ric Flair and Ricky Steamboat, sending Sting into retirement undefeated as a tag champion.
Back on this day in 2021, Jade Cargill made their AEW debut against Shaq vs. Cody Rhodes vs. Red Velvet, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.20.
Rewind to 2023, when Boudreaux & Strickland went straight to headlining on debut as a team, appearing on Rampage, rated 4.87.

secondaries.text: Rewind to 2024, when Eddie Kingston vs. Bryan Danielson fought tooth and nail for the ROH World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Revolution, rated 8.47 ? a fantastic contest. It was the 20th time the ROH World Heavyweight Title had been on the line, a nice marker in that championship's story. In an emotional grudge match tied to Danielson's disrespect of his idol Jun Akiyama, Kingston retained the Continental Crown Championship ? and earned a handshake of respect from Danielson afterward.

2024 brought us this moment: the AEW International Title had a new owner by the end of the night as Roderick Strong vs. Orange Cassidy battled it out, appearing on Revolution, rated 7.28 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle ? ending the champion's reign at 12 defenses. For Roderick Strong, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. Strong pinned Cassidy clean with the End of Heartache to become the new AEW International Champion, with a returning Kyle O'Reilly appearing during the celebration.

Rewind to 2024, when Samoa Joe vs. Adam Page vs. Swerve Strickland fought tooth and nail for the AEW World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Revolution, rated 8.08 ? a genuinely great match. Joe choked out Page in a three-way world title match, narrowly retaining after Page and Strickland had briefly teamed up to try to take him out.
